# THT Design Guide — Southern Machinery (SMThelp)

> Through-hole (THT) auto insertion PCB design guidelines: hole diameter, hole span,
> datum holes, clinch specification, warpage limits, and DIP insertion rules for radial,
> axial and odd-form components. Includes live DFM calculators and a 14-point
> auto-insertion readiness checklist. Published by Southern Machinery, a Shenzhen-based
> designer and manufacturer of SMT and THT assembly equipment, founded in 2011.

Source: https://dgl.smthelp.eu/
Language: English (interface also available in Spanish, Portuguese, French, Arabic, Russian, Chinese)
Last updated: 2026-09-17

## Core reference data

### Hole diameter
- Guided insertion (lead captured by the insertion tooling):
  `Hole diameter = Maximum lead diameter + 0.48 mm ± 0.08 mm` (0.019 in ± 0.003 in)
- Unguided insertion:
  `Hole diameter = Maximum lead diameter + 0.58 mm ± 0.08 mm`
- Maximum lead diameter is the **diagonal of the lead cross-section**, not its width:
  `C = √(A² + B²)`. Example: a 0.64 mm × 0.38 mm rectangular lead gives C = 0.74 mm.
- Undersized holes cause insertion faults and mis-seating; oversized holes let the component
  sit loose, the clinch has nothing to bite against, and parts drop out during wave soldering.

### Axial lead span (minimum insertion hole span)
Four tooling families, four formulas — `span = [(Body length × factor) + constant] − Lead diameter`:
- Standard tooling: `[(Body length × 1.112) + 2.36 mm] − Lead diameter`
- Large lead tooling: `[(Body length × 1.085) + 4.11 mm] − Lead diameter`
- 5 mm tooling: `[(Body length × 1.109) + 1.40 mm] − Lead diameter`
- 5.5 mm tooling: `[(Body length × 1.067) + 2.30 mm] − Lead diameter`
- Non-symmetrical components: subtract a further **0.41 mm (0.016 in)** from the maximum
  body length before applying the formula.
- Use the **maximum** body length, not the nominal — vendors change body dimensions between
  production lots without changing the part number.

### Maximum body diameter
- `Max body diameter = Fixed form length − (2 × board thickness)`
- Form length is 10.69 mm (0.420 in) for standard, high-density and large-lead tooling;
  11.68 mm (0.460 in) for 5 mm and 5.5 mm tooling.
- Worked example: 1.57 mm board, standard tooling → `10.69 − (2 × 1.57) = 7.55 mm`

### DIP insertion
- `Minimum hole diameter = Maximum lead diameter + Hole location tolerance + 0.25 mm (0.010 in)`

## Site structure
- **Design Guide** — full DFM rules for board, axial, radial and DIP insertion, with 11 reference tables
- **DFM Check** — 14-point auto-insertion readiness checklist with live scoring
- **Case Data** — project requirement form used in field evaluation
- **Insights** — 10 technical articles, full text published as static HTML
- **Videos & Catalog** — 30 machine videos and 20 product catalogs
- **ROI Tools** — four DFM calculators (hole diameter, axial span, radial pitch, body diameter)

## Company
- **Southern Machinery Sales And Service Co Limited** (brand: SMThelp)
- Shenzhen, Guangdong, China — founded 2011
- Designs and manufactures SMT and THT machines for the Smart EMS factory
- Capability: radial · axial · odd-form · terminal & riveting · board handling · wave & selective soldering
- **50+ machines shipped overseas since 2009**, covering Brazil, India, Malaysia, Indonesia,
  Thailand, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Ecuador, Colombia and Argentina
- A US LED display manufacturer achieved **5× the throughput of manual assembly** after
  automating radial insertion with Southern Machinery equipment (2022)
- Feeders, nozzles and gripper tooling are designed and manufactured in-house
- Contact: info@smthelp.com · https://wa.me/8613602562576 · https://www.smthelp.com
